newsitem.title: UK: Firm currency hits thin UK grain futures market.
newsitem.headline: Firm currency hits thin UK grain futures market.

text.p: A firm pound sterling hit UK grain futures during Tuesday on a thin market.
"Nothing exciting is happening, it's all down to currency," said a trader.
Wheat futures closed one to 0.25 stg down after trading 342 lots, while barley was 0.50 stg down on 229 lots, most of which were crossed.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
Only light trading was reported on the UK cash markets, with feed wheat trading at 99 stg for Jan and 102 stg for May in the fob sector ex-east coast ports.
